title: Managing Strategic Reviews
overview: Business reviews—whether conducted monthly, quarterly, annually, internally, externally, departmentally, or organization-wide—can vary significantly in their effectiveness. While some reviews may feel routine and unproductive, others can spark insightful discussions on strategic direction, uncover growth opportunities, and drive outstanding results. This course is centered on optimizing these reviews, offering a platform for key influencers to openly and transparently discuss the progress of strategic initiatives, resolve business challenges, and continually shape a desired future based on past performance.
audience: This program is ideal for managers, section heads, operations managers, and senior executive assistants who are eager to introduce, develop, and manage efficient and productive business reviews.
methodology: The course employs a blend of interactive methods, including roundtable discussions on various business cases, and debates on the current status of the business and how to address strategic challenges. Participants will also receive a detailed plan for conducting business reviews, along with templates they can apply in their day-to-day roles.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Develop a deep understanding of the importance of business reviews
Clearly define the business review process
Identify and build essential competencies needed for preparing business reviews
Successfully conduct and manage business reviews
Assess outcomes, assign actions, and ensure follow-through on outstanding tasks
